app.name: Snake Duel
app.about: Two snakes, one apple at a time: race the computer's snake to 15 apples without crashing into a wall or either body. Arrows/WASD, swipes or a gamepad.

files.index.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Snake Duel</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin:0; height:100%; background:#0f1410; color:#e9f2ea; font-family:system-ui, sans-serif; overflow:hidden; touch-action:none; }
  canvas { display:block; width:100vw; height:100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
// Snake Duel: two snakes on one field, one apple at a time. You steer the green one (arrows/WASD, swipes or a
// gamepad); the computer steers the orange one toward the apple, avoiding walls, both bodies and dead ends.
const COLS = 32, ROWS = 20, WIN = 15;
const c = document.getElementById("c"), g = c.getContext("2d");
let W, H, cell, ox, oy;
function fit() { const d = devicePixelRatio || 1; W = innerWidth; H = innerHeight; c.width = W * d; c.height = H * d; g.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0);
  cell = Math.floor(Math.min((W - 20) / COLS, (H - 70) / ROWS)); ox = Math.floor((W - cell * COLS) / 2); oy = Math.floor((H - cell * ROWS) / 2) + 22; }
addEventListener("resize", fit); fit();

const DIRS = { up: [0, -1], down: [0, 1], left: [-1, 0], right: [1, 0] };
let you, cpu, apple, state = "title", tick = 0, step = 0.11, wins = { you: 0, cpu: 0 }, msg = "";
function snake(x, y, dir) { return { body: [[x, y], [x - dir[0], y - dir[1]], [x - 2 * dir[0], y - 2 * dir[1]]], dir, next: dir, grow: 0, score: 0, alive: true }; }
function reset() { you = snake(6, 10, DIRS.right); cpu = snake(25, 9, DIRS.left); apple = place(); state = "play"; tick = 0; step = 0.11; }
function occupied(x, y) { return [you, cpu].some((s) => s.body.some(([a, b]) => a === x && b === y)); }
function place() { for (;;) { const x = Math.floor(Math.random() * COLS), y = Math.floor(Math.random() * ROWS); if (!occupied(x, y)) return [x, y]; } }
const free = (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < COLS && y < ROWS && !occupied(x, y);

// The computer: of the moves that do not crash, prefer those that leave room (a flood fill) and get closer to
// the apple; sometimes it hesitates, so it can be beaten.
function room(x, y, limit) {
  const seen = new Set([x + "," + y]), q = [[x, y]];
  while (q.length && seen.size < limit) { const [a, b] = q.shift(); for (const [dx, dy] of Object.values(DIRS)) { const k = (a + dx) + "," + (b + dy); if (!seen.has(k) && free(a + dx, b + dy)) { seen.add(k); q.push([a + dx, b + dy]); } } }
  return seen.size;
}
function think() {
  const [hx, hy] = cpu.body[0];
  let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
  for (const d of Object.values(DIRS)) {
    if (d[0] === -cpu.dir[0] && d[1] === -cpu.dir[1]) continue;
    const nx = hx + d[0], ny = hy + d[1];
    if (!free(nx, ny)) continue;
    const space = room(nx, ny, cpu.body.length * 3 + 20);
    const dist = Math.abs(nx - apple[0]) + Math.abs(ny - apple[1]);
    const score = (space < cpu.body.length + 4 ? -1000 : 0) - dist * 3 + Math.min(space, 60) * 0.2 + Math.random() * 2.5;
    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = d; }
  }
  if (best) cpu.next = best;
}
function move(s) {
  s.dir = s.next;
  const [hx, hy] = s.body[0], nx = hx + s.dir[0], ny = hy + s.dir[1];
  return [nx, ny];
}
function update() {
  think();
  const a = move(you), b = move(cpu);
  const crash = (s, [x, y], other) => !(x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < COLS && y < ROWS) || you.body.some(([p, q], i) => p === x && q === y && !(s === you && i === you.body.length - 1 && !you.grow))
    || cpu.body.some(([p, q], i) => p === x && q === y && !(s === cpu && i === cpu.body.length - 1 && !cpu.grow)) || (x === other[0] && y === other[1]);
  you.alive = !crash(you, a, b); cpu.alive = !crash(cpu, b, a);
  if (!you.alive || !cpu.alive) return over(!you.alive && !cpu.alive ? "Both crashed: a draw." : !you.alive ? "You crashed. The computer wins." : "The computer crashed. You win!", !you.alive && cpu.alive ? "cpu" : you.alive ? "you" : "");
  for (const [s, p] of [[you, a], [cpu, b]]) {
    s.body.unshift(p);
    if (p[0] === apple[0] && p[1] === apple[1]) { s.grow += 2; s.score++; apple = place(); beep(s === you ? 660 : 330); step = Math.max(0.06, step - 0.002); }
    if (s.grow > 0) s.grow--; else s.body.pop();
  }
  if (you.score >= WIN || cpu.score >= WIN) over(you.score >= WIN ? "You reached " + WIN + " apples first!" : "The computer reached " + WIN + " apples first.", you.score >= WIN ? "you" : "cpu");
}
function over(text, who) { state = "over"; msg = text; if (who) wins[who]++; beep(who === "you" ? 880 : 160); if (window.kimi) kimi.storage.set("wins", wins).catch(() => {}); }

const keymap = { ArrowUp: "up", KeyW: "up", ArrowDown: "down", KeyS: "down", ArrowLeft: "left", KeyA: "left", ArrowRight: "right", KeyD: "right" };
function steer(name) { const d = DIRS[name]; if (state === "play" && d && !(d[0] === -you.dir[0] && d[1] === -you.dir[1])) you.next = d; }
addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (keymap[e.code]) { e.preventDefault(); steer(keymap[e.code]); }
  if ((e.code === "Enter" || e.code === "Space") && state !== "play") reset();
  if ((e.code === "KeyP" || e.code === "Escape") && (state === "play" || state === "paused")) state = state === "play" ? "paused" : "play";
});
let touch = null;
addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { touch = [e.clientX, e.clientY]; if (state === "title" || state === "over") reset(); });
addEventListener("pointerup", (e) => { if (!touch) return; const dx = e.clientX - touch[0], dy = e.clientY - touch[1]; if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) > 24) steer(Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) ? (dx > 0 ? "right" : "left") : (dy > 0 ? "down" : "up")); touch = null; });
let actx = null;
function beep(f) { try { actx = actx || new AudioContext(); const o = actx.createOscillator(), v = actx.createGain(); o.frequency.value = f; v.gain.value = 0.04; o.connect(v).connect(actx.destination); o.start(); v.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, actx.currentTime + 0.12); o.stop(actx.currentTime + 0.12); } catch (e) {} }

function draw() {
  g.fillStyle = "#0f1410"; g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g.fillStyle = "#162019"; g.fillRect(ox, oy, cell * COLS, cell * ROWS);
  g.font = "600 16px system-ui"; g.textAlign = "center"; g.fillStyle = "#e9f2ea";
  g.fillText(`You ${you ? you.score : 0}  ·  Computer ${cpu ? cpu.score : 0}   (first to ${WIN})   ·   wins ${wins.you}–${wins.cpu}`, W / 2, oy - 10);
  if (apple) { g.fillStyle = "#e8505a"; g.beginPath(); g.arc(ox + (apple[0] + 0.5) * cell, oy + (apple[1] + 0.5) * cell, cell * 0.38, 0, 7); g.fill(); }
  for (const [s, col, head] of [[you, "#46a37b", "#7fdcae"], [cpu, "#d98a3a", "#ffc27a"]]) {
    if (!s) continue;
    s.body.forEach(([x, y], i) => { g.fillStyle = i ? col : head; g.fillRect(ox + x * cell + 1, oy + y * cell + 1, cell - 2, cell - 2); });
  }
  const banner = (a, b) => { g.fillStyle = "rgba(15,20,16,.85)"; g.fillRect(ox, oy + cell * ROWS / 2 - 50, cell * COLS, 100); g.fillStyle = "#e9f2ea"; g.font = "650 28px system-ui"; g.fillText(a, W / 2, oy + cell * ROWS / 2 - 6); g.font = "15px system-ui"; g.fillStyle = "#b7c9b9"; g.fillText(b, W / 2, oy + cell * ROWS / 2 + 24); };
  if (state === "title") banner("Snake Duel", "Arrows/WASD or swipe · race the orange snake to " + WIN + " apples · Enter or tap to start");
  if (state === "over") banner(msg, "Enter or tap to play again");
  if (state === "paused") banner("Paused", "P to go on");
}
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
  const pads = navigator.getGamepads ? [...navigator.getGamepads()].filter(Boolean) : [];
  if (pads[0]) { const [x, y] = pads[0].axes; if (Math.abs(x) > 0.5 || Math.abs(y) > 0.5) steer(Math.abs(x) > Math.abs(y) ? (x > 0 ? "right" : "left") : (y > 0 ? "down" : "up")); }
  if (state === "play") { tick += dt; while (tick >= step && state === "play") { tick -= step; update(); } }
  draw(); requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
if (window.kimi) { kimi.storage.get("wins").then((w) => { if (w) wins = w; }).catch(() => {}); kimi.on("visible", (v) => { if (!v && state === "play") state = "paused"; }); }
</script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: A 2D snake game against the computer: both snakes on one field race for one apple at a time, first to 15 wins; the computer avoids walls, bodies and dead ends but hesitates sometimes so it can be beaten; swipes and a gamepad too.
note: A seed entry: a game that does not come with KimiLM, to show installing from the registry
